articles.summary: TiVo Ads Q2 2026 advertising and related revenue grew 54% year over year as advertisers increased engagement, app launches and audience reach across premium CTV experiences TiVo Ads today announced significant growth and momentum, with the TiVo One advertising platform surpassing 6.3 million monthly active users globally as of June 2026, a 70% year-over-year increase, while delivering record advertising and related revenue growth of 54% year over year in Q2 2026. The company also continued to expand its advertising inventory, audience data capabilities and distribution footprint as brands increasingly seek more effective ways to reach engaged television audiences. In one notable highlight, a leading global streaming platform’s TiVo Ads campaign increased monthly app launches by 70% as compared to the prior month, highlighting the effectiveness of reaching consumers directly during content discovery. This momentum reflects growing adoption of TiVo Ads' home page advertising solutions,
articles.title: TiVo One Ad Platform Surpassed 6.3 Million Monthly Active Users, Delivered Record Q2 Revenue Growth and Expanded Global Advertising Footprint
